result:
All three screens render with exact spec labels, and forward/back navigation both work in the Simulator. Phase 1 (App shell) is complete and verified end-to-end: Home → Health/Transcribe → back to Home, with matching labels and disabled-state styling on the not-yet-wired buttons.

Summary of changes:
- Rewrote `src/pages/main/App.vue` as the Home screen (title/subtitle + Health/Transcribe buttons navigating via `sparkling-navigation`'s `open`).
- Added `src/pages/health/` and `src/pages/transcribe/` pages as static placeholders per §3.2/3.3, each with a back-to-Home link using `close()`.
- Removed the unused `src/pages/second` template page.
- Updated `app.config.ts` entry/router maps to `main`/`health`/`transcribe`.
- Extended `src/App.css` with shared neutral, native-feeling styles (buttons, status line, cards, section headers).

Both gates pass: `npm run build` and the `xcodebuild` Debug/iOS-Simulator build succeed, and I confirmed via a Simulator install + idb-driven taps that navigation and labels work correctly.
